title: Post-hoc configuration-history control for VLAN-mismatch RQ1 instances
purpose: Test whether an equivalent pre-fault normalized configuration reference can recover the temporal signal that produced the five Proposed-only correct diagnoses in the VLAN-mismatch family.

diagnostic_rule.name: CONFIG_HISTORY_ONLY
diagnostic_rule.current_state_first: Run the existing Configuration-only diagnosis on the post-fault normalized state. If it already returns a represented non-ALLOW cause, retain that result.
diagnostic_rule.history_fallback: When current-state diagnosis returns ALLOW/NONE, compare sanitized pre-fault and post-fault normalized configuration. If routes and firewall policies are unchanged, non-VLAN interface attributes are unchanged, and VLAN/interface-VLAN semantics changed on the configured VLAN device, return UNKNOWN/VLAN for that device. Otherwise abstain with UNKNOWN/UNKNOWN.
diagnostic_rule.scope_note: This is a targeted temporal-reference control in the single-fault VLAN-mismatch laboratory, not a general historical-configuration diagnosis algorithm.

primary_metrics: strict correctness: verdict and fault domain

interpretation_rule.if_5_of_5_strict_correct: Equivalent normalized configuration history can recover the temporal VLAN-drift signal in all five evaluated instances; the original RQ1 gain should be attributed to availability of a pre-fault temporal reference rather than unique information in flow evidence.
interpretation_rule.if_less_than_5_of_5_strict_correct: The implemented configuration-history control does not fully recover the temporal signal; any residual advantage of Proposed must be described only for these evaluated instances and not generalized beyond the control design.
